scripts.translation: 雷根贝勒的道路宽阔又明亮~修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国，人人皆知~

scripts.text: The investigation is looking good, but could you stop this ridiculous behavior.
scripts.translation: 调查进展不错，但你能不能别再做这种荒唐事了？

scripts.text: I thought the VIP said there were only two conditions? Besides, everyone has already heard me.
scripts.translation: 我记得贵宾只提了两个条件吧？再说，大家都听见我说的话了。

scripts.text: We're now officially travelers from the Schwarzwald Republic. It would be hard to look around while hiding everywhere we went to anyway.
scripts.translation: 我们现在可是名正言顺的修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国游客。反正一路躲躲藏藏，也没法好好四处查看。

scripts.text: Traveling here is truly awesome~ I can feel this excitement. How do you think historians will write this day?
scripts.translation: 在这里旅行真棒~我都能感受到这份兴奋了。你说历史学家会怎么记下今天？

scripts.text: Kaya, relax. Leave your problems behind and just pretend you're on a holiday. You'll get a clearer perspective.
scripts.translation: 卡雅，放轻松。把烦恼抛到脑后，就当出来度假。这样才能看得更清楚。

scripts.text: First, try to look around on this trip. See how you feel about it.
scripts.translation: 先趁这趟旅行四处看看，感受一下。

scripts.text: What should you do if you feel something? You should act upon it.
scripts.translation: 要是察觉到什么，就采取行动。

scripts.text: A small report~ It's not just to admire and do nothing, right?

scripts.text: Surely... there's a reason why you're traveling with us.
scripts.translation: 吧？你肯定有理由跟我们一起旅行...

scripts.text: By the way, did the VIP feel uncomfortable with non-fair use of the First Class? The start is uncomfortable, but the rest of the journey will be smooth.
scripts.translation: 对了，贵宾会不会觉得我们违规蹭头等舱有点不自在？刚开始可能不太习惯，后面的旅程就会顺利了。

scripts.text: When I went by train, that felt like more First Class. Was it a good experience?
scripts.translation: 我以前坐火车时反而觉得那更像头等舱。体验怎么样？

scripts.text: The VIP is getting familiar with us, it will give him some inspiration. Ahahaha.
scripts.translation: 贵宾渐渐熟悉我们了，说不定能从中得到些启发。啊哈哈哈。

scripts.text: The VIP wants to be economical. I understand. Let me explain our plan as economically as possible.
scripts.translation: 贵宾想省事，我明白。那我就尽量简明扼要地说明计划。

scripts.text: Here at Lighthalzen, the downtown and the slums coexist with one another. Both sides has structures that make it hard to easily cross the railway from the side to the other.
scripts.translation: 里希塔乐镇同时有市区和贫民区。铁路和两边的建筑阻隔了交通，想从一边到另一边并不容易。

scripts.text: Normally, we'd all be issued a pass to go around freely, but we don't have time for now this is the best I've managed to prepare.
scripts.translation: 平时我们都会拿到可以自由通行的证件，不过现在来不及了。这是我目前能弄到的最好办法。

scripts.text: Oh, don't worry it's kind of a free pass for our agents. Of course, you don't need to know more.
scripts.translation: 别担心，这算是我们特工用的免费通行证。当然，细节你就不用知道了。

scripts.text: This is Pat's home. This is where Pat first got into contact with Rekenber and met a staff member.
scripts.translation: 这里是帕特的家。他就是在这里第一次接触雷根贝勒公司，并认识了一位职员。

scripts.text: Pat probably worked hard to get a chance out of poverty and live a better life. He wanted to start anew.
scripts.translation: 帕特大概一直很努力，想摆脱贫困、过上更好的生活。他想重新开始。

scripts.text: Heyo! There you are. Mom, Dad, how are you?
scripts.translation: 嘿！你们在这儿啊。爸爸、妈妈，最近好吗？

scripts.text: Oh, he's the one who's been searching for Patrick a while ago.
scripts.translation: 哦，他就是之前一直在找帕特的人。

scripts.text: Aah, that's you! Did you meet... with Pat?
scripts.translation: 啊，是你啊！你见到...帕特了吗？

scripts.text: Why'd you think they lose someone who was doing well in the Enterprise?
scripts.translation: 你觉得一个在公司里干得好好的人，怎么会失踪呢？

scripts.text: No, something is definitely not right! He's not the type of person that would ^0000FFjust stop contacting us.^000000
scripts.translation: 不，肯定有什么不对劲！他绝不是那种会突然停止联系我们的人。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: If you're not too busy, perhaps you could keep looking! I'm doing everything to send the paychecks all the way!
scripts.translation: 如果你不太忙，能不能继续帮忙找找？我也一直在想办法把工资寄回来！

scripts.text: It's how we're able to provide for Pat. But it's strange we haven't heard back from him yet.
scripts.translation: 们还指望这笔钱养活帕特呢。可奇怪的是，我们一直没收到他的消息。

scripts.text: Heeey~ Mom, don't fight with Dad.
scripts.translation: 嘿~ 妈妈，别和爸爸吵架。

scripts.text: I came here with a very high ^0000FFimportant^000000 member of your son's company. What did I tell you the other day? He's came to see the welfare of the families who have hired special talent.
scripts.translation: 我今天是陪你儿子公司里一位重要人物来的。我之前不是说过吗？他是来探望公司聘用的特殊人才的家属。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Yes, that's him. You can ask him questions as much as you'd like. He came here for this sole reason.
scripts.translation: 没错，就是他。你们想问什么都可以。他就是专程为这件事来的。

scripts.text: Hello~ I don't really know where to begin... Thank you for taking in my son, my family isn't worried having enough food to survive anymore. Thank you, thank you.
scripts.translation: 你好~我都不知道该从哪儿说起...谢谢你们雇用了我儿子。现在家里至少不用再担心吃不上饭了。谢谢，真的谢谢。

scripts.text: You may think my son isn't worthy but he's very good at fixing things.
scripts.translation: 你可能觉得我儿子没什么本事，但他很会修东西。

scripts.text: Thanks to the employment, I have a job and can feed my family now. I take pride in it.
scripts.translation: 多亏这份工作，我现在也有活干，能养活家人了。我很珍惜这份工作。

scripts.text: But, we don't even know if he's alive or not.
scripts.translation: 可是，我们甚至不知道他还活着没有。

scripts.text: I wonder whether or not I should go to the company and ask for him directly, I'm busy at work and I can't contact him.
scripts.translation: 我在想，要不要直接去公司找他。可我工作忙，也没法联系上他。

scripts.text: I don't want to get in trouble with the company, I told my son to follow orders and not complain.
scripts.translation: 我不想和公司闹僵，所以一直叫儿子服从安排、别抱怨。

scripts.text: If there's a problem on how things are going, please let us know. From his childhood, he's always been listening closely and he can fix anything.
scripts.translation: 要是事情有什么不对劲，请一定告诉我们。他从小就很专注，也什么东西都会修。

scripts.text: Please honey! You're not asking the important questions. Is there any regulation prohibiting my son from contacting us? I haven't contacted since the day my child was hired, I can't even contact him myself...
scripts.translation: 亲爱的！你问的不是重点。公司有没有规定不准我儿子联系我们？自从孩子受雇以来，我就没联系上他，甚至连我自己都没法联系他...

scripts.text: There are no regulations to restrict personal contact. We also pay holidays based on the government's recommendation... Your son says he's on vacation.
scripts.translation: 没有规定禁止员工和家人联系。我们也按照政府的建议安排休假...你们的儿子说他正在休假。

scripts.text: So you mean to say Patrick wouldn't even come visit us?
scripts.translation: 所以，你的意思是帕特连回家看看都没有？

scripts.text: Maybe he doesn't like us anymore... ^0000FFOn my first vacation^000000, I just came back to my family and talked to them.
scripts.translation: 也许他已经不喜欢我们了...我第一次休假时，就回家和家人聊了聊。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Oh, I can do that when I'm at work!
scripts.translation: 哦，我上班时也能抽空回

scripts.text: What the hell are you doing with the Enterprise people! How come it's gone this far!
scripts.translation: 家！你们公司的人到底在搞什么鬼？怎么把事情弄成这样！

scripts.text: Gosh! Mom, Dad! Thank you! So you can't even contact him, aren't you curious what's happening with him? I'm sure you are.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！爸爸、妈妈，谢谢你们！既然你们一直联系不上他，难道不想知道他出了什么事吗？我想你们肯定很想知道。

scripts.text: We'll meet with your son, keep going with our investigation and then contact you. You can both trust me and wait. You believe me right?
scripts.translation: 我们会去见你们的儿子，继续调查，然后再联系你们。相信我，耐心等消息，好吗？

scripts.text: Oh my~ I can't believe it. Thank you so much. I'm afraid it will be hard for us to contact you...
scripts.translation: 哎呀~真不敢相信。太感谢了！只是我们可能很难联系到你们...

scripts.text: Aaah~ how to contact you! No matter what! Please contact us again, even if we're busy!
scripts.translation: 啊...要怎么联系你们呢！不管怎样，请一定再联系我们，就算我们忙也没关系！

scripts.text: Did you hear all of that? As stated in the documents, they never even got a call after he joined the Enterprise. Well, I don't like seeing them like that, but I have to keep my first tourist promise.
scripts.translation: 你都听见了吧？和资料里写的一样，他加入公司后就再没给家里打过电话。我也不忍心看他们这样，不过答应第一个游客的事还是得办到。

scripts.text: I'm sure the employees don't come visit their home during their vacations. Isn't it a ^0000FFprivacy matter^000000 that is none of our business?
scripts.translation: 我想员工休假时不一定会回家探亲。这是个人隐私，和我们无关，对吧？ ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: And you think it's like that for everyone in these documents? No way? Pat is a family person, do you really think he wouldn't come back home when he's on vacation because of personal problems? Do you really believe that?
scripts.translation: 你觉得资料里的每个人都这样吗？怎么可能！帕特很顾家，你真觉得他休假时会因为个人原因不回家？你真这么想？

scripts.text: Yes, you. Your guard doesn't look like someone who enjoys sitting in a hotel, so how about you? Don't you meet with the people you know during your vacations?
scripts.translation: 没错，就是问你。你看起来不像会整天坐在旅馆里的人。那你呢？休假时不去见见熟人吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I often meet with my family during my vacations, sometimes even my friends.
scripts.translation: 是的，我休假时经常和家人见面，有时也会和朋友见面。

scripts.text: See? I knew it. Who wouldn't do that? Okay sure. Maybe one guy out of ten.
scripts.translation: 看吧，我就知道。谁会不这么做呢？好吧，十个人里也许会有一个例外。

scripts.text: The company doesn't investigate private matters. It's private for a reason. Ask yourself if you'd want someone else to look into your private matters.
scripts.translation: 公司不会调查员工的私事，隐私之所以叫隐私，自有道理。想想看，你愿意让别人调查自己的私事吗？

scripts.text: Aah~ Do you want to meet with them for a few more minutes~ Will the VIP come here again?
scripts.translation: 啊~贵宾还想和他们多聊几分钟吗~以后还会再来吗？

scripts.text: I think I heard as much as I need to here. We'll find the rest of the information in the headquarters.
scripts.translation: 我觉得该了解的都了解了。剩下的资料去总部找吧。

scripts.text: The people who made these documents don't know anything about Pat. It's not just one or two persons on this list. Should you really listen to one person?
scripts.translation: 写这些资料的人根本不了解帕特。这份名单上可不止一两个人。你真的只听信一个人的说法吗？

scripts.text: Aren't you tired of walking this path narrow, steep path?
scripts.translation: 走这条又窄又陡的路，你不累吗？

scripts.text: Are you tired already? There are people like this everyday. As your people suffer, more people suffer, so much that you can't even recognize pain.
scripts.translation: 你已经累了吗？每天都有人像这样受苦。受苦的人越来越多，久而久之，你甚至会对痛苦麻木。

scripts.text: Hello~ I'm just a tourist guide, how can I give you orders. The judgment is done by the VIP's intellect, reasoning and conscience~
scripts.translation: 你好~我只是个导游，怎么会命令你呢？该怎么判断，就看贵宾的智慧、推理能力和良知了~

scripts.text: Alright! We're going to follow up with Pat, so the tour's next location will be at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 好！我们接着追查帕特。导游的下一站是<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Alright! We're going to follow up with Pat, so the tour's next place will be at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 好！我们接着追查帕特。导游的下一站是<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Adventurer! You're here! Who else would it be?
scripts.translation: 冒险者！你来了！除了你还能是谁呢？

scripts.text: You're finally here. Am I too fast for you? Or do you think perhaps it's because the VIP's shoes are not suited for long distances?
scripts.translation: 你总算来了。我走得太快了吗？还是贵宾的鞋子不适合走远路？

scripts.text: Ah! Well done. I wanted to introduce her to you. She's the fiance of ^0000FFanother missing person^000000 on the list.
scripts.translation: 啊，正好。我来给你介绍一下。她是名单上另一位失踪者的未婚妻。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Her fiance was hired by the Rekenber, and then she wasn't able to contact him anymore. Of course, she tried to contact the company and asked what was going on, but what did they tell her?
scripts.translation: 她未婚夫受雇于雷肯贝尔，之后她就再也联系不上他了。当然，她也联系过公司，问到底出了什么事，可公司怎么回答她的？

scripts.text: Hey Eva! Hello! Come over here, over here!
scripts.translation: 嘿，伊娃！你好！过来，来这边！

scripts.text: Daisy? Hi. Do you have more information on what happened?
scripts.translation: 黛西？你好。关于发生的事，你有更多的信息吗？

scripts.text: Oh, that? I don't know yet, but I came here with the Vice President to find out.
scripts.translation: 你说那件事啊？我还不知道，不过我这次是陪副总裁来查清楚的。

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right. You have something to tell him? Go ahead!
scripts.translation: 没错，就是他。有什么话想对他说就直说吧！

scripts.text: This will be good, I don't regret getting out of bed today!
scripts.translation: 今天起床真是起对了，居然能碰上这种事！

scripts.text: What happened to Marcus? Give me my Marcus back! It's been 2 years since I haven't heard from Marcus!
scripts.translation: 马库斯到底怎么了？把我的马库斯还给我！我已经两年没收到他的消息了！

scripts.text: You're looking for Marcus? Mar...cus... Holzman. He's from the East of Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation: 你在找马库斯？马...库斯...霍兹曼。他来自里希塔乐镇东部...

scripts.text: Oh, what a coincidence. He's also from the Lighthalzen slums!
scripts.translation: 哦，真巧。他也来自里希塔乐镇的贫民区！

scripts.text: Maybe he doesn't want to contact you anymore?
scripts.translation: 也许他不想再联系你了？

scripts.text: Marcus would never do that to me! My Marcus... Marcus...
scripts.translation: 马库斯绝不会那样对我！我的马库斯...马库斯...

scripts.text: No matter what the truth is, I don't know a third person with the same issue as yours.
scripts.translation: 不管真相如何，我还没遇到第三个和你有同样遭遇的人。

scripts.text: Even if Marcus's thoughts about me had changed, he's not the only one!
scripts.translation: 即使马库斯对我的想法变了，他也不是唯一一个！大多

scripts.text: Most of the people from the slums that are hired by the Rekenber ^0000FFcannot be reached anymore.^000000
scripts.translation: 数被雷肯贝尔雇佣的贫民窟居民都再也联系不上了。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Do you really think everyone would change their minds like that? To their family? Their friends? Even lovers? It's a bigger issue!
scripts.translation: 你真觉得所有人都会这样变心吗？对家人、朋友，甚至恋人都不闻不问？这问题严重得多！

scripts.text: What the hell did Rekenber do with their employees?!
scripts.translation: 雷肯贝尔到底对员工做了什么？！

scripts.text: I would like to know more details about this. Let's go back. If we make a disturbance here, they'll call the police.
scripts.translation: 我想进一步了解情况。我们先回去吧，在这里闹起来会惊动警察。

scripts.text: What? Do you want to throw me out?
Am I a problem to you? Do you think I'll give up easily? I will keep coming until I find Marcus!
scripts.translation: 你们添麻烦了吗？你以为我会轻易放弃？找不到马库斯，我就会一直来！

scripts.text: She said he saw the VIP...
What are you trying to say?
You're a VIP. You're so beautiful, I'm very impressed. Tsk. Tsk. Tsk.
scripts.translation: 您就是贵宾啊。真漂亮，让我佩服得五体投地。啧啧啧。

scripts.text: Listen carefully. As I said before, joining Rekenber is the envy of most people in the slums. If you can't imagine how excited it is for them, then maybe you can't think.
scripts.translation: 仔细听。正如我之前说的，加入雷肯贝尔是贫民区居民梦寐以求的机会。你要是想象不出他们有多兴奋，那还真是缺乏想象力。

scripts.text: For such people, Rekenber has been giving out special gifts as part of social welfare, don't you know about it. Rekenber is tricking people.
scripts.translation: 雷肯贝尔一直打着社会福利的名义，给这些人发特别补助。你不知道吗？公司是在骗人。

scripts.text: Are you disrespecting the company's welfare business? I get the same treatment as those who have been specially selected.
scripts.translation: 你是在质疑公司的福利政策吗？那些特别选中的人和我享受的是同等待遇。

scripts.text: That's not what I'm saying VIP. The secretary here knows too. Do you really not know? Are you pretending?
scripts.translation: 贵宾，我说的不是这个。这里的秘书也知道这件事。你真的不清楚？还是在装傻？

scripts.text: Have you seen Rekenber's criteria for their special offer?
scripts.translation: 你看过雷肯贝尔特别补助的条件吗？身体

scripts.text: People who have healthy body and no families. Among them, why would they only pick the poorest?
scripts.translation: 健康、没有家人。在符合条件的人里，他们为什么偏偏只挑最穷的？

scripts.text: What do you think this means? Why only people with good health~ or no money~ then they disappear only to get paychecks to their house~
scripts.translation: 你觉得这说明什么？为什么偏偏挑身体健康~或家境贫困~的人？这些人失踪后，公司却还照常把工资寄回家~

scripts.text: But there's a single missing person around me.
scripts.translation: 可我身边就有一个人失踪了。

scripts.text: You're a guard? Your guard is from the borders of Rune-Midgard, right?
scripts.translation: 你是卫兵吧？你这位卫兵来自鲁恩米德加尔特边境，对不对？

scripts.text: It's easy to recognize a person from their personality and their tone of voice. It's easy for anyone to know, but I can see it just by looking at your face.
scripts.translation: 从人的性格和说话方式就能看出他的来历。别人或许没那么容易看出来，但我光看你的脸就知道。

scripts.text: Speaking of personalities, I'm like a guard myself and our spirits can't be broken. You can't break me like a wheel, I'll fight back.
scripts.translation: 说到性格，我自己也像个卫兵，意志坚强，绝不会被击垮。想打倒我？我可不会屈服，还会反击。

scripts.text: I would rather use force than make compromises.
scripts.translation: 我宁愿使用武力，也不愿做出妥协。

scripts.text: Hah! That's it, that's the spirit. The type that day to day! You would have never allowed your friends to have gone missing just like that. Your personality is what saved our guard, for now anyway.
scripts.translation: 哈哈！就是这股劲！你果然是个干脆利落的卫兵！朋友失踪时，你绝不会坐视不管。至少到目前为止，是你的性格救了这位卫兵。

scripts.text: Anyway do you have a special unit in your guard? I know the answer already.
scripts.translation: 总之，你的卫兵中有特殊部队吗？我已经知道答案了。

scripts.text: I knew it. The VIP says you all get the same treatment. But he won't give security to the people of the slums.
scripts.translation: 我就知道。贵宾说你们都享受同等待遇，可贫民区的人却得不到

scripts.text: The people in your team are the kind of people who don't go missing.
scripts.translation: 保护。你们队里的人可不会轻易失踪。

scripts.text: Simply because it's more troublesome to make a guard disappear. It makes more noises.
scripts.translation: 因为让卫兵失踪要麻烦得多，还会闹出更大动静。

scripts.text: With the money and the welfare paychecks, isn't it easier to just make someone disappear from a vulnerable family and then make their voices unheard?
scripts.translation: 有钱，又有福利金打掩护，要让弱势家庭里的人消失，再堵住家人的嘴，不是更容易吗？

scripts.text: Do you even know what you're insinuating now? It's all speculations!
scripts.translation: 你知道你在暗示什么吗？这全是猜测！

scripts.text: Do you really know what I'm thinking?
scripts.translation: 你真的知道我在想什么吗？

scripts.text: Come in and check it out yourself!
Let's see why they never made contact. I don't know what they did during their vacations, but we can see where they are now.
scripts.translation: 看他们为什么一直没有联系。我不知道他们休假时做了什么，但至少能查出他们现在在哪里。

scripts.text: Hah, this guy, he's still all about privacy. Are statistics and odds not part of the economy? Why do all of these people go and never contact their house again?
scripts.translation: 哈，这家伙还在讲隐私。统计和概率不算经济学的一部分吗？这么多人出去后就再也不联系家里，难道不奇怪？

scripts.text: Why are they giving their salaries?
scripts.translation: 为什么他们还在发工资？

scripts.text: Our adventurer asked a good question. They are almost all from the slums. In Rekenber, they offer you accommodations, with meals and lodging, you hardly have to spend any money at all.
scripts.translation: 冒险者问得好。他们几乎都来自贫民区。在雷肯贝尔工作，公司会提供食宿，你几乎不用花什么钱。

scripts.text: If the adventurer is from a poor family, and you have to support it, would you spare money for your meals?
scripts.translation: 如果冒险者出身贫寒，又需要供养家人，你还会把钱花在吃饭上吗？

scripts.text: These accommodations for the low-income classes is Rekenber's contribution to society. We do our best!
scripts.translation: 公司为低收入者提供住宿，这是对社会的贡献。我们已经尽力了！

scripts.text: Ahah! Was I not polite enough? Our VIP is getting angry~ But the adventurer and I have gone to many places before, we know these things.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈！是我不够礼貌吗？我们的贵宾要生气了~ 不过冒险者和我之前去过很多地方，我们懂这些。

scripts.text: It's an illegal laboratory. You know what an illegal laboratory is?
scripts.translation: 这是非法实验室。你知道这种地方是做什么的

scripts.text: It would be used for illegal experiments with human life? Used like a lab rats?
scripts.translation: 吗？用来进行非法人体实验？把人当成实验白鼠？

scripts.text: Aren't you imagining too much now.
scripts.translation: 你想象力未免太丰富了吧。

scripts.text: Our guard here and the VIP are not imaginative? I know you don't see to look at what's in front of you, but look at the reality of the situation here.
scripts.translation: 难道我们这位卫兵和贵宾就没有想象力吗？我知道你们不愿看眼前的事实，但看看这里到底是什么情况。

scripts.text: Do you know what your colleagues ate and what they were doing before the day was over?
scripts.translation: 你知道你的同事们在一天结束前吃了什么、做了什么吗？

scripts.text: Did the VIP know about the disappearance of his employees until I pushed to investigate about it?
scripts.translation: 要不是我坚持追查，你这位贵宾到现在还不知道自己的员工失踪了吧？

scripts.text: I still cannot conclude that they're missing.
scripts.translation: 我仍然不能断定他们失踪了。

scripts.text: Alright, I see. Let's call it a problem, not a missing person. Do you feel better then? If it makes it easier for you, I'll call it that. Do you even want to solve this problem in a positive light?
scripts.translation: 好吧，我明白了。那就叫“出了问题”，不叫“有人失踪”。这样你就好受些了吗？你喜欢的话，我就这么说。可你真的想积极解决问题吗？

scripts.text: Perfect, I had hoped you'd say that. I'm glad to see you're not angry anymore. So open your mind~ don't get angry~ breath slowly~ exhale~
scripts.translation: 太好了，我就盼着你这么说。很高兴你没再生气。放宽心~别生气~慢慢吸气~再呼出来~

scripts.text: If you're right, then let's check it out at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 如果你是对的，那我们就去<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>看看吧。

scripts.text: The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation: 雷根修芦的道路宽阔而闪亮~ 大家都知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国~

scripts.text: Hello, how may I help you?
We've finally enter the Rekenber's headquarters. I wonder if Pat was relieved when he first passed through this door. Where did he go next?
scripts.translation: 我们终于进了雷肯贝尔总部。帕特第一次走进这扇门时，应该也松了口气吧。他接下来去了哪里？

scripts.text: Do all employees go through OT?
scripts.translation: 所有员工都要先参加入职

scripts.text: I thought they would assign them to their department directly.
scripts.translation: 培训吗？我还以为他们会直接分配到各自的部门。

scripts.text: Ah yes, you're right. For the special talented people, they must go through OT first and then they are assigned to their own respective department.
scripts.translation: 没错。特别人才得先参加入职培训，之后才会分配到相应部门。

scripts.text: It's a system based on their ^0000FFplace of origin^000000. There are many people who are not familiar with the corporate culture. After many trials and errors, the new employees are now required to go through OT.
scripts.translation: 这是根据他们的出身背景制定的制度。很多人不熟悉企业文化，经过多次摸索调整，现在新员工都必须参加入职培训。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Let's go the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> where Pat started his life at Rekenber.
scripts.translation: 去<NAVI>[会议室]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，帕特就是在那里开始了雷肯贝尔的职业生涯。

scripts.text: I think the others went to the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, where the meetings are held. Shouldn't you be going?
scripts.translation: 我想其他人去了<NAVI>[会议室]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，也就是开会的地方。你不也该过去吗？

scripts.text: Do you need an assistance with something?
Let's ask this guy for information.
Do you know Kaufmann? Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 你认识考夫曼吗？帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: The Vice President is looking for Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 副总裁正在寻找考夫曼。

scripts.text: I see, what is the purpose. And... who are you again?
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了。找考夫曼有什么事？还有...你刚才说你是谁来着？

scripts.text: Are you the secretary of the Vice President?
What are you talking about? Did your secretary get hit on the head? You sound like an outsider?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？你们秘书是不是撞到头了？怎么听起来像个外行？
我在找帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: You, who are you... ? I've seen that face before... are you...?
scripts.translation: 你...你是谁？我好像在哪里见过你...难道你是...？

scripts.text: Aaah! Yes, right, right!!! ...Vice President? Oh, hello!
scripts.translation: 啊！是的，没错，没错！！！...副总裁？哦，您好！

scripts.text: Do you know anything about Patrick Kaufmann?
scripts.translation: 你知道帕特里克·考夫曼的情况吗？

scripts.text: Patrick Kaufmann... I know him. He's a good friend of mine. He has rough hands but his work is fast and accurate.
scripts.translation: 帕特里克·考夫曼...我认识他，是我的好朋友。他手掌粗糙，但干活又快又准。我

scripts.text: I tried to keep him around longer, but they took him to the lab.
scripts.translation: 本想让他多留一阵子，可他们把他调去实验室了。

scripts.text: Yes, there. The newcomers must be in the company for ^0000FFat least a whole year^000000 before they can be sent to another department or a new workplace, unless they are given a ^0000FFspecial request.^000000
scripts.translation: 是的，就是那里。新员工必须在公司工作至少整整一年，才能调往其他部门或工作地点，除非有特别调动申请。 ^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: But why would I send newcomers in the first place? I ignored the requests even though it came from above. But even so, some of the newcomers here were sent elsewhere anyway.
scripts.translation: 可我为什么要调走新员工？上面发来调动要求时，我明明都拒绝了。即便如此，这里的新人还是有一些被调走了。

scripts.text: Well you see... I need more people for repairs. There's always something broken, so I always need more manpower. But recently,
scripts.translation: 是这样的...我需要更多人手维修设备。这里总有东西坏掉，所以一直缺人。可最近，

scripts.text: There's been ^0000FFa  lot more workforce requested.^000000
scripts.translation: FF申请调走的人手多了很多。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Do you know why so many people were drafted?
scripts.translation: 你知道为什么这么多人被抽调吗？

scripts.text: I don't know for sure. Many people in our department get injured while working, and our newcomers are all very strong.
scripts.translation: 我也不清楚。我们部门有不少人工作时受伤，而新员工都很强壮。他们只调走那些

scripts.text: They only take those who are ^0000FFvery good at their job.^000000
But if you are pressured from above, you have to abide and give them the workforce, right?
scripts.translation: 可要是上面施压，我们也只能服从，把人手交出去，对吧？

scripts.text: Which laboratory were they sent to?
scripts.translation: 他们被送到了哪个实验室？

scripts.text: The annex one. Oh, do you want to go? I haven't been there in a while, it's quite hard to get inside. If you don't mind, could you send people back here?
scripts.translation: 是附属实验室。哦，你们要去那里吗？我很久没去过了，进去不太容易。方便的话，能把那些人带回来

scripts.text: Anyway, please be careful, it is a dangerous place.
scripts.translation: 吗？总之要小心，那里很危险。

scripts.text: Ooh.. You cannot be transferred at least until a whole year, unless you are given ^0000FFan unusual request.^000000
scripts.translation: 噢...除非有特别调动申请，否则至少要在公司干满一年 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: But Pat didn't get neither one of these reasons. Is it really a laboratory?
scripts.translation: 才能调岗。可帕特两项都不符合。那地方真是实验室吗？

scripts.text: Did you know this VIP? was there anything about this in your documents? Why did the lab only take healthy and you people?
scripts.translation: 贵宾，你认识他吗？资料里有提到这件事吗？实验室为什么只调走健康又年轻的人？

scripts.text: I need to know why they broke the contract rules.
scripts.translation: 我需要知道他们为什么违反契约规定。

scripts.text: I was in charge of Regenschirm, but I've never seen Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 我负责雷根修芦，但从没见过帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: Yeah? You're getting curious too now, aren't you! Is that right?
scripts.translation: 是吗？你现在也开始好奇了吧？我说得没错吧？

scripts.text: I will guide you, follow me. Let's go to <NAVI>[Regenschirm]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 我带你们过去，跟紧我。我们去<NAVI>[雷根修芦]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: They are waiting for you at the <NAVI>[laboratory]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, shouldn't you go as well?
scripts.translation: 他们在<NAVI>[实验室]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>等你，你不也该去吗？

scripts.text: There doesn't seem to be any room left.
scripts.translation: 看起来已经没有空位了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, let's go quickly? Let's go together.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，快走吧！我们一起过去。

scripts.text: You came all the way to the office, what's going in? You left me alone in here and then just disappeared.
scripts.translation: 你们大老远跑到办公室来，到底想干什么？把我一个人留在这里，自己却不见了。为什么

scripts.text: Do you know who's the gentlemen next to me?
scripts.translation: 你知道我身边这位先生是谁吗？

scripts.text: Ah! Nice to meet you. My name is Daisy. I'm an old friend of the Vice President.
scripts.translation: 啊！幸会，我叫黛西，是副总裁的老朋友。

scripts.text: Hello there. I'm called Gray Earl.
I'm usually not in these places, we should continue this meeting in the Vice President's office.
scripts.translation: 。我平时不在这里办公，我们去副总裁办公室继续谈吧。

scripts.text: You don't have to. Here will be just fine. What are you doing in this place anyway? Were you waiting for someone?
scripts.translation: 不用了。在这里就好。你在这里做什么？是在等什么人吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I noticed something odd about the Vice President's absence, so I went out to see what was going on.
scripts.translation: 是的，我注意到副总裁缺席有些不对劲，所以出去看看发生了什么。

scripts.text: If you keep waiting outside like that, don't you think it looks even more suspicious?
scripts.translation: 如果你一直像那样在外面等，难道不觉得更可疑吗？

scripts.text: So you were hiding on purpose. Can you tell what this was all about?
scripts.translation: 所以你们是故意躲着我？能告诉我这到底是怎么回事吗？为

scripts.text: That was our plan. I'm cooperating with these people.
scripts.translation: 那是我们的计划。我正在和这些人合作。

scripts.text: I didn't think we'd be friends with these people again.
scripts.translation: ！我没想到我们还能和这些人再做朋友。

scripts.text: Why? Can't we be friends? You! You'll have to explain yourself!
scripts.translation: 为什么不能做朋友？你！倒是得好好解释一下！

scripts.text: You don't need to know more about this. The less you know, the better. When we finish the investigation, we'll let you know.
scripts.translation: 你不用知道太多，知道得越少越好。调查结束后，我们会告诉你。

scripts.text: So, do you know who's in charge of moving the workforce from one department to another? Is it someone you trust?
scripts.translation: 那么，你知道谁负责跨部门调动员工吗？那个人可靠吗？

scripts.text: Do you want the employee transfer logs? They are kept in the document storage room.
scripts.translation: 你要查员工调动记录吗？记录保存在文件仓库里。

scripts.text: If you want to uncover secrets, it would wiser to straight to the document storage room and search for the documents yourself than going through the Human Resource department.
scripts.translation: 要查出真相，最好直接去文件仓库找资料，比通过人力资源部更方便。

scripts.text: Let me tell you where you can find these trustworthy documents.
scripts.translation: 让我告诉你可以在哪里找到这些可靠的文件。

scripts.text: There are many eyes around here. You know what I mean, right?
scripts.translation: 这附近眼线很多，你明白我的意思吧？

scripts.text: Go to the <NAVI>[Document Storage Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, go quickly before someone notice you.
scripts.translation: 快去<NAVI>[文件仓库]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，赶在有人注意到你之前。

scripts.text: Don't you have something else to do.
scripts.translation: 你难道没有别的事要做吗？

scripts.text: Hello, this is the document storage room.
Ah! I see. You're looking for Patrick Kaufmann's transfer logs?
scripts.translation: 啊，我明白了。你们在找帕特里克·考夫曼的调动记录？

scripts.text: Yes, that's why we're here. Have you found what we're looking for?
scripts.translation: 是的，这就是我们来这里的原因。你找到我们要找的东西了吗？
帕特里克·考夫曼。转移代码12-4332。

scripts.text: He was working as part of the facility maintenance department and then transferred to a new facility.
scripts.translation: 他原本在设施维护部门工作，后来被调到了新设施。记录上说，

scripts.text: It says the director, McDonald, came here directly and gave a list of people to transfer.
scripts.translation: 总监麦克唐纳亲自来过，还交给我们一份调动人员名单。

scripts.text: Do you still have that list?
Oh, there it is. I found it.
Daisy, can you compare the list please.
scripts.translation: 黛西，麻烦你对照一下这两份名单。

scripts.text: Hmm.. there are many overlap with the names from both lists. I expected as such... but I'm confused.
scripts.translation: 嗯...两份名单上的人有很多重合。我早就料到了...可还是觉得奇怪。

scripts.text: Does Kaufmann still work at McDonald's laboratory?
scripts.translation: 考夫曼还在麦克唐纳的实验室工作吗？

scripts.text: Well... the fact is, some of the facility maintenance employees work outside of the labs.
scripts.translation: 嗯...事实是，有些设施维护部门的员工会在实验室之外工作。

scripts.text: Patrick was from the same department, so maybe it was the same for him.
scripts.translation: 帕特里克来自同一个部门，所以也许他也是这样。

scripts.text: I've been told we are not allowed to transfer people until at least a whole year, but what is the reason why Kaufmann was transferred?
scripts.translation: 我听说，员工至少要在公司工作满一年才能调岗。那考夫曼为什么会被调走？

scripts.text: Well... there's reason to do that here. Once a request is received from the lab, we approve it. It's a top priority.
scripts.translation: 嗯...这里有特殊情况。只要实验室提出调动申请，我们就会批准，而且优先处理。

scripts.text: So where is Kaufmann right now?
scripts.translation: 那么考夫曼现在在哪里？

scripts.text: As I told you before, I work around the clock... there are many laboratories here and there, I'm not sure which ones are still operational or not.
scripts.translation: 就像我之前说的，我几乎全天都在工作...这里到处都是实验室，我也不清楚哪些还在运作。

scripts.text: We don't keep track of all the trips and movements inside the headquarters. I hear a lot, though.

scripts.translation: 嗯...看来没法轻易说服他们。我们先商量一下。

scripts.text: No matter how much I tried to persuade them, they didn't listen. It's not easy to change someone's mind. I should discuss it with Tes.
scripts.translation: 无论我怎么劝说，他们都不肯听。改变一个人的想法并不容易。我应该和泰斯商量一下。

scripts.text: The Vice President, Kaya Tos, is going to persuade them. Let's listen to him.
scripts.translation: 副总裁卡雅·托斯要去劝他们。我们听听他怎么说。

scripts.text: I can't get through to them just with words.
scripts.translation: 光靠言语是无法让他们回头的。

scripts.text: You cannot use force against innocent people.
scripts.translation: 你不能对无辜的人使用武力。

scripts.text: Even so, we might have to. We split in two teams, one of them keeps them from pursuing, and the rest enter and keep investigating.
scripts.translation: 即便如此，恐怕也只能这么办。我们分成两队，一队拦住他们，另一队进去继续调查。

scripts.text: That sounds like a good idea.
Everything here is mine! I won't let you harm my friends! I'm not messing around!
scripts.translation: 这里的一切都是我的！别想伤害我的朋友！我可不是在开玩笑！

scripts.text: Who gave you permission to approach my staff? You see them? Just try putting one hand on them, and I'll blow you up.
scripts.translation: 谁允许你靠近我的职员了？你看到了吗？只要敢碰他们一下，我就把你炸上天。

scripts.text: No matter how stupid you are, it's always better to have your hands on your wrists, right?
scripts.translation: 再蠢也该知道，手还是长在自己手腕上比较好吧？

scripts.text: You all look like skeletons, why aren't you hiding? You will all disappear!
scripts.translation: 你们看起来都瘦成骷髅了，怎么还不躲起来？你们会全都消失的！

scripts.text: Aaaaah!! Researcher! It's us! We're here too!
scripts.translation: 啊啊啊！！研究员！是我们！我们也在！

scripts.text: You know what! If you have soybeans and rice, which one do you choose?
scripts.translation: 你知道吗！黄豆和大米，你会选哪个？赶时

scripts.text: If you're in a hurry, you'll just mix them up!
scripts.translation: 间的话，就把它们混在一起！

scripts.text: What, what? Come on? Why is our attack.. not working...?
scripts.translation: 怎么回事？我们的攻击...为什么没用...？

scripts.text: Why? Why are they not budging? What about this?
scripts.translation: 为什么？为什么他们纹丝不动？那这个呢？

scripts.text: Oh, I've been hit! We should escape!
scripts.translation: 哦，我被击中了！我们快逃吧！

scripts.text: Why are they doing so well? Did we pick the wrong test subjects?
scripts.translation: 他们怎么这么能打？难道我们挑错实验对象了？

scripts.text: I'm also a high-end pro who gets money!! We don't have time to decide who's superior! Hurry up!
scripts.translation: 我也是收钱办事的专业人士！！没空争谁更厉害了，快跑！

scripts.text: No! Let me go! Now! I can't believe we can't avoid that kind of weapon! Let me go! Let me go!!
scripts.translation: 不！快让我走！我可不想挨那种武器的打！放开我！放开我！！

scripts.text: I'll move the people to a safe location.
scripts.translation: 我会把伤员转移到安全的地方。

scripts.text: Let the rest of the people here look at where they went.
scripts.translation: 让剩下的人在这里查看他们去了哪里。

scripts.text: Some should stay here to watch out in case they come back, the rest of us will head to the <NAVI>[safe place]<INFO>sp_cor,122,141,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!
scripts.translation: 留几个人在这里警戒，以防他们回来。其他人跟我去<NAVI>[安全地点]<INFO>sp_cor,122,141,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>！

scripts.text: This place is incredibly nice looking, it's hard to believe they do experiments here. Even I would want to live in a place like this.
scripts.translation: 这里的环境看起来非常好，很难相信他们在这里进行实验。换作是我，也会想住在这种地方。

scripts.text: The problem is. We can't use force on them. What should we do?
scripts.translation: 问题是，我们不能对他们动武。接下来怎么办？

scripts.text: Didn't you say the Vice President of Rekenber was going to convince them? What do you want to talk to me about?
scripts.translation: 你不是说雷肯贝尔的副总裁会去劝他们吗？找我有什么事？

scripts.text: I don't think this is going to work. What do you think Tes will say? The fight is still going on.
scripts.translation: 我看这样不行。泰斯会怎么决定？那边还在打呢。

scripts.text: It's dangerous here. Move over to the safe area!
scripts.translation: 这里很危险。快转移到安全区域去！

scripts.text: The Vice President is going to convince them.
scripts.translation: 副总裁会去劝服他们的。

scripts.text: Didn't Tes tell you to take action? If you aren't prepared, you should do that now.
scripts.translation: 泰斯不是让你采取行动吗？如果你还没准备好，那就现在准备。

scripts.text: I'm so curious what the inside looks like~
scripts.translation: 我很好奇里面是什么样子的~

scripts.text: These people aren't armed? What are they playing at?
scripts.translation: 这些人没有携带武器？他们在搞什么鬼？

scripts.text: I don't feel so well. We should get ready.
scripts.translation: 我有种不祥的预感。我们得做好准备。

scripts.text: It's nice here and quiet. If only I could get a day off...
scripts.translation: 这里很安静，也很舒服。要是能请一天假就好了...

scripts.text: What is this big mansion in front of us? I've never seen anything like this before.
scripts.translation: 前面那座大宅子是什么？我以前从未见过这样的地方。

scripts.text: Who said it? Who's going to kick our butts?!
I came out to see what was that commotion, what is happening?!
scripts.translation: 我出来看看是什么动静，到底发生什么事了？！

scripts.text: Are you seeing this? Show yourselves! Come on out!
scripts.translation: 你们看到了吗？出来吧！别躲躲藏藏的！

scripts.text: I don't know why I keep standing here. If they asked something, I just decline. They're stamina monsters.
scripts.translation: 我不知道为什么我一直站在这里。如果他们问什么，我就拒绝。他们的体力真好。

scripts.text: Today is supposed to be day off, but what is this! Are you responsible for it commotion?
scripts.translation: 今天本来是休息日，怎么闹成这样！这场骚动是你们引起的吗？

scripts.text: I'll have a warm drink when this is over!!
scripts.translation: 等这一切结束后，我要喝杯热饮！！

scripts.text: This may be hard for you, but please investigate the entrance first.
scripts.translation: 这事可能有点棘手，但请先去调查入口。

scripts.text: No, really, just a little bit, I'm late am I? What is this all about, is it drugs?
scripts.translation: 不是...就迟到了一小会儿。我迟到了吗？这到底怎么回事，是毒品

scripts.text: Was I really this late? What is all of this, why is everyone wounded?
scripts.translation: 吗？我真的来晚这么多吗？怎么回事，大家怎么都受伤了？

scripts.text: Can't you tell from what you can see? Help with the work if you are free, there's no time to explain.
scripts.translation: 你看不到吗？如果有空就帮忙干活，没时间解释了。

scripts.text: Hey, I was worried about all of this!
scripts.translation: 喂，我刚才可是一直在担心大家！

scripts.text: I can't... the chief researcher attacked us.
scripts.translation: 我不行了...是首席研究员袭击了我们。

scripts.text: I was the one who made all this stuff and never once questioned it...
scripts.translation: 这些东西都是我做的，我却从来没怀疑过...

scripts.text: Do you still trust the researchers? Is that what you're saying?
scripts.translation: 你还信那些研究员吗？你是这个意思吗？

scripts.text: No that's not it, I just can't believe it. Ugh, I'm so tired...
scripts.translation: 不，不是那样，我只是不敢相信。唉，我好累...

scripts.text: Please stay here, I will check the surroundings.
scripts.translation: 请留在这里，我去周围查看一下。

scripts.text: Take a look at the condition of the injured.
Do you know who she was?
Yes, she's one of the senior researchers, her name is ^0000CDElyumina.^000000
scripts.translation: 是的，她是高级研究员，叫Elyumina。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: It was stupid thing to come and attack directly. What are they studying?
scripts.translation: 直接冲进来袭击他们，真够蠢的。他们到底在研究什么？

scripts.text: That's because I'm the only mechanic in the lab. I don't care about anything other than my own machines...
scripts.translation: 因为我是实验室里唯一的机械师。我只关心自己的机器...

scripts.text: Now that I think about it, her eyes were not normal. She looks like a crazy person.
scripts.translation: 现在想想，她的眼神确实不正常，简直像个疯子。

scripts.text: Have you ever seen her room? I was frightened when I saw it the first time. She closed the door quickly, but I saw it.
scripts.translation: 你见过她的房间吗？我第一次看到时吓坏了。她很快就把门关上了，不过我还是看见了里面。

scripts.text: Are you saying you've witnessed an illegal experiment?
scripts.translation: 你是说，你目击了非法实验？

scripts.text: Yeah, maybe it was. These machines moved strangely. Huh...
scripts.translation: 嗯...也许真是非法实验。那些机器动得很奇怪...

scripts.text: Do you trust what we've been saying now?
scripts.translation: 现在你相信我们说的话了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I believe you! I absolutely believe you now!
scripts.translation: 是的，我相信你们！我现在完全相信你们了！

scripts.text: If it's not the vice president, who else would we trust!
scripts.translation: 如果不是副总裁，我们还能相信谁呢！

scripts.text: Good. We can continue with our investigation now. Vice President, please give me the documents.
scripts.translation: 好，那我们可以继续调查了。副总裁，把文件给我吧。

scripts.text: The list of missing people. I need to double check with who we have here.
scripts.translation: 失踪人员名单。我得和这里的人核对一下。

scripts.text: Here, stand in line please. Make three rows. Please tell me your full name when your turn comes.
scripts.translation: 请大家排好队，分成三列。轮到你时，告诉我全名。

scripts.text: Vice President, a moment... I have something to report
scripts.translation: 副总裁，请等一下...我有事要报告。

scripts.text: It's not something I can tell you here, so please come over <NAVI>[here]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 这里不方便说，请跟我来<NAVI>[这里]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Didn't you see <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> going with the Vice President? I'm worried about the wounded people.
scripts.translation: 你没看到<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>跟副总裁一起走了吗？我得照看伤员。

scripts.text: It will take some time to finish the investigation and gather all the data here.
scripts.translation: 完成这里的调查并收集所有数据还需要一些时间。

scripts.text: This place is very dangerous. Come back when you're strong enough to protect your own body.
scripts.translation: 这里很危险。等你有能力保护自己后再回来。

scripts.text: I hope we can find all the missing people here. I really do.
scripts.translation: 我希望我们能找到这里所有的失踪者。我是真心的。

scripts.text: It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the injured. Let's go see what she wants to talk about.
scripts.translation: 看起来<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很担心伤员。我们去看看她有什么事。

scripts.text: Adventurer. Could I speak with you for a moment please?
scripts.translation: 冒险者。能占用你一点时间吗？

scripts.text: You and others previously attacked a lab that's been conducting illegal experiments.
scripts.translation: 你和同伴之前袭击过一个进行非法实验的实验室。你觉

scripts.text: What do you think about this one?
I think this lab is the same.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这里也是同样的情况。

scripts.text: I think this lab has also been doing illegal experiments. So... could I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation: 我认为这里也在进行非法实验。所以...能拜托你一件事吗？

scripts.text: I think this is the laboratory where the ^0000FFmissing people were sent to.^000000 Besides the people in this area, there might be other that we can't see right now.
scripts.translation: 我认为这里就是失踪人员被送来的地方。除了眼前这些人，可能还有其他失踪者被关在我们看不到的地方。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I would like you to ^0000FFcontinue investigating Patrick Kaufmann's case.^000000
scripts.translation: 我希望你能继续调查帕特里克·考夫曼的下落。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: If he worked here, the others might people here know something about him.
scripts.translation: 00000如果他曾在这里工作，其他人或许知道些什么。

scripts.text: Maybe... this is the last chance we'll have to find Patrick after all.
scripts.translation: 也许...这真的是我们找到帕特里克的最后机会了。

scripts.text: I have something else to do right now.
It's okay, you don't have to look right now. There are other urgent matters to take care of.
scripts.translation: 没关系，你不用现在就去。还有更紧急的事要处理。

scripts.text: But please think of Kaufmann when you can.
scripts.translation: 但请你在方便的时候想想考夫曼的事。

scripts.text: Thank you. I'm sorry to have had to ask you this so suddenly.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。很抱歉这么突然地向你提出这个请求。

scripts.text: I would like you to continue investigating Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 请继续调查帕特里克·考夫曼的下落。如

scripts.text: Maybe if he worked here, the others might know something about it.
scripts.translation: 果他曾在这里工作，其他人或许知道些什么。

scripts.text: Oh, welcome back adventurer. Come. Kaufmann, did you find him?
scripts.translation: 哦，欢迎回来，冒险者。过来吧。找到考夫曼了吗？

scripts.text: This is Kaufmann's...? Were there other people there?
scripts.translation: 这是考夫曼的...？那里还有其他人在吗？

scripts.text: - I told Kaya the story about the researcher you met at Rudus and about the experiments. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卡雅讲述了在鲁德斯遇见的研究员，以及那些实验。 -

scripts.text: Why didn't the researcher come back with you?
scripts.translation: 为什么那个研究员没有和你一起回来？

scripts.text: She didn't want to come back...
Alright. Later, I will send a specialist to look for a body or remains. Again, Your services must be properly rewarded.
scripts.translation: 好。稍后我会派专家去寻找遗体或遗骸。你的帮助理应得到报酬。

scripts.text: If you have the time, I hope you will give these experiments a proper rest. There is no one other than you... the adventurer, to see them through.
scripts.translation: 如果你有空，希望你能让这些实验受害者安息。能完成这件事的，只有你这位冒险者了。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to keep asking these hard task for you. If you can bring me their bracelets, I will reward you.
scripts.translation: 总是让你做这么棘手的事，真抱歉。若能带回他们的手镯，我会给你报酬。

scripts.text: I will go back to the headquarters with the list of missing people. I'll use the bracelets as evidence and send the necessary compensation to their families.
scripts.translation: 我会带着失踪人员名单返回总部，用这些手镯作为证据，并向他们的家属支付应有的补偿。

scripts.text: All future work will be handled through ^0000FFAas over here^000000. I will hand the bracelets to Aas.
scripts.translation: 接下来的工作由这里的阿斯负责。我会把手镯交给她。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Thank you for everything you have done so far.
scripts.translation: 感谢您迄今为止所做的一切。

scripts.text: I would like you to continue investigating Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 我希望你能继续调查帕特里克·考夫曼。也

scripts.text: Maybe if he worked here, the others might know something about it.
scripts.translation: 许如果他曾在这里工作，其他人可能知道一些情况。

scripts.text: It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the wounded people. Let's hear what she wants to talk about.
scripts.translation: 看起来<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很担心伤员。我们去听听她要说什么。

scripts.text: We don't know when there will be an enemy attack. Come back when you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation: 我们不知道敌人什么时候会发动攻击。等你能够保护自己时再回来吧。

scripts.text: I honestly had no idea this place was hidden here. How the hell did they manage to avoid the surrounding people's attention?
scripts.translation: 我真没想到这里竟然藏着这样一个地方。他们到底怎么瞒过附近的人，把这里藏起来的？

scripts.text: What's the status of the wounded people?
They're being looked at seriously, but we're also getting some paperwork done about them.
scripts.translation: 他们正在接受治疗，我们也在为他们办理相关手续。

scripts.text: As we started treating them, we've found some ^0000FFserious health issues^000000 in addition to their injuries.
scripts.translation: 开始治疗后，我们发现他们除了伤势之外，还有严重的健康问题。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: It seems they were ^0000FFpoisoned^000000 while moving waste materials and their clothes were contaminated by various dangerous substances used in the lab because they didn't have safety equipment.
scripts.translation: 他们搬运废料时似乎中了毒。由于没有安全装备，衣服也沾上了实验室使用的各种危险物质。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: She didn't even follow basic safety rules. How many have been poisoned?
scripts.translation: 她连最基本的安全规程都不遵守。到底有多少人中毒？

scripts.text: Yes, only the people resting over there...
scripts.translation: 是的，只有那边休息的人...

scripts.text: Oh! The reporting site wasn't looking too good!
But, when I die... what about my family... my family...
scripts.translation: 可是...我死了的话，我的家人怎么办...我的家人...

scripts.text: Didn't you say we were about to die?
scripts.translation: 你刚才不是说我们快死了吗？

scripts.text: I said your bodies weren't healthy, but who said anything about dying?
scripts.translation: 我只是说你们的身体状况不好，谁说你们会死了？

scripts.text: Can I rest? Shouldn't I get back to work? If I don't work, my family will starve.
scripts.translation: 我能休息吗？我不该回去工作吗？不工作的话，家里人就没饭吃了。

scripts.text: I'm sick too! If I sleep, it will be cured in a day!
scripts.translation: 我也生病了！只要睡一觉，一天就能好！

scripts.text: Oh. About that. You need professional treatment and care.
scripts.translation: 这个嘛...你们需要接受专业治疗和护理。

scripts.text: No, it's not okay. I have to... I need to work.
scripts.translation: 不，不行。我必须...我需要工作。

scripts.text: Then you'll really die. I don't think you want to die yet, right?
scripts.translation: 再这样下去你真的会没命的。你还不想死

scripts.text: If you keep working, you will. You need to rest and be treated by professionals.
scripts.translation: 吧？继续工作就会出事。你得休息，接受专业治疗。

scripts.text: I can't keep working as the Vice President while the Enterprise is in this state.
scripts.translation: 企业已经变成这样，我不能继续当副总裁。

scripts.text: Are you going to just get rid of us? If it's not you, it'll be someone else!
scripts.translation: 你们是想把我们甩掉吗？就算不是你，也会换别人来！

scripts.text: I'll be taking care of this disaster instead. I will do everything to ensure your full recovery.
scripts.translation: 我会先处理这场灾难，尽一切努力让你们完全康复。

scripts.text: I'm glad to hear not all of you are bad people.
scripts.translation: 很高兴听到你们不全是坏人。

scripts.text: If you are unhealthy, you should focus on getting better first.
scripts.translation: 身体不舒服的话，先专心养好身体。

scripts.text: My Angela... I'll finally be able to see my Angela again....
scripts.translation: 我的安吉拉...我终于能再见到安吉拉了...

scripts.text: But, well... what about us? We're in a relationship...
scripts.translation: 但是，嗯...那我们呢？我们是在一起的...

scripts.text: Still, I want to keep working. We can write anywhere right? If we had a seat back at our headquarters...
scripts.translation: 可我还是想继续工作。到哪儿都能写东西，对吧？总部要是有张桌子给我就好了...

scripts.text: I do not know if there are jobs available back at headquarters.
scripts.translation: 我不确定总部有没有空缺，我会

scripts.text: I'll check up on that once.
Isn't there ^0000FFa lot of work^000000 to do here too? There's still waste materials... right? But I don't think the gunmen will stay here for more than a day or two.
scripts.translation: 这里不是也有很多工作要做吗？还有废料要处理...对吧？不过那些枪手应该待不了一两天。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: You know, we need people to chop trees, cook, clean, and who will wash our clothes? I don't think it's possible.
scripts.translation: 你想想，砍树、做饭、打扫都得有人做，还有谁来洗我们的衣服？你们肯定忙不过来。

scripts.text: What? Are we even strong enough to eat food?
scripts.translation: 什么？我们连自己吃饭都没力气吗？

scripts.text: No way... we know where to catch the fishes... where the good mushrooms are... where the best spots for the bathroom are... you guy don't know any of that.
scripts.translation: 别开玩笑了...我们知道去哪儿捕鱼，哪儿能采到好蘑菇，哪儿方便上厕所...你们可不知道这些。

scripts.text: She's right! Nobody else knows this place as much as we do.
scripts.translation: 她说得对！没人比我们更熟悉这里。

scripts.text: Hmm... well, I guess we need to keep people here who knows this place. Alright, I've decided.
scripts.translation: 嗯...看来确实得留下熟悉这里的人。好，我决定了。

scripts.text: Anyone who's in good enough shape and wishes to remain can stay here and they will still be hired.
scripts.translation: 身体状况允许、也愿意留下的人，都可以继续留在这里工作。

scripts.text: As Lazy was saying, I think Rekenber has used these people because of their desperation.
scripts.translation: 正如懒散所说，我认为雷肯贝尔利用了他们走投无路的处境。

scripts.text: We need support from the adventurer!
